title: skill_normalise
description: LLM FALLBACK output for llm.normalise_skill, used only when the rule-first alias dictionary misses. The mapping is logged to a merge-review file so the human can approve it before the catalogue trusts it.

canonical_id.description: The canonical skill id this raw term maps to. Use an existing id from config.skill_aliases when possible; otherwise a new lowercase snake id. Empty string if the term is not a tool/skill.

confidence.description: 0-1 confidence in the mapping. Low confidence → the merge stays unapproved.
